mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.plate_no AS plateNo, p.pass_reason AS passReason, p.pass_time AS passTime, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.status, p.station_id AS stationId, s.name AS stationName, u.nickname AS operatorName, p.operator_time AS operatorTime, p.check_result AS checkResult, p.remark, p.reserve1, p.reserve2, p.creator, p.updater, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime FROM pass_record p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON p.operator_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(p.pass_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM pass_record p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.pass_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND p.pass_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND p.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(p.pass_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(p.pass_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayPassCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '异常记录' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS abnormalPassRate FROM pass_record p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.pass_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND p.pass_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND p.station_id = #{stationId}
